doc.title: Marshall Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 19, 2021

title: How Sun Ra disciplined band members
summary: Sun Ra never fired anyone but put them in the discipline box with endless tasks.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: How would he fire somebody in the band?
How would he have fired someone in the band?
He doesn’t fire anybody really. He’d put them in the discipline box you know. And they go up under his discipline. So that means if you walk out the door he’d go, “Wait a

minute, before you go, do this for me, do that. I can’t find this.” And it might be right up under him, but he’d have you looking all night for it. Because he’s got so many discipline ways. Make you work, make you write music, make you do a lot of things and see what you’re gonna do.
